content: rapidfuzz vs difflib (PyPI + benchmarks cross-verified): rapidfuzz MIT (vs FuzzyWuzzy GPLv2), C++ core with bit-parallel/SIMD Indel kernels, ~order-of-magnitude faster than difflib's pure-Python Ratcliff-Obershelp; official 2-100x claim is vs FuzzyWuzzy not difflib; 2025 peer-reviewed multilingual benchmark (5 libs, 5 languages, 50k cases, DOI 10.55151/ijeedu.v7i1.188): rapidfuzz ~40% faster + memory-efficient, difflib slowest. API: process.extract/extractOne(query, choices, scorer=fuzz.WRatio, limit=N) returns (choice, score 0-100, index); score scale differs from difflib 0-1 (migration care). CyDifflib (MIT, same author ecosystem) = drop-in difflib API acceleration (ratio 0.200s->0.060s) if API compatibility preferred. For DYM over FTS vocab: extract with score_cutoff + doc-frequency ranking.
